Greetings from Zensar Technologies, Pune

We are hiring for CA Freshers for Pricing Analyst roles. We are looking for an innovative and self-starting Finance professional to support driving our business's competitiveness and profitability.

This position will be a key enabler in accelerating our business growth and success. As part of the Central Business Finance the role will provide you with the opportunity to develop into a key business leader as the impact and scale of the pricing function grows.

In this role, you will be a subject matter expert in competitor pricing and market movements, a key contributor to defining and evolving pricing strategies across all service lines, and the internal authority on standardized pricing and commercial models to optimize deal wins, value delivery and deal profitability.

You should possess a solid knowledge and depth of experience in quantitative and qualitative data analysis methods, bringing to bear through exacting actionable insights to executing and evolving our pricing strategies

Basic Criteria :

• CA Qualified

• Must have interest to work in Finance & Pricing

• Basic knowledge of our industry, specifically as it relates to market and competitor positioning, offerings, pricing approaches & strategies, and general trends

• Proficiency in data modelling using Excel/VBA and/or other relevant toolsets.

• Excellent verbal and written communication skills

• Effective reporting and presentation skills

• Enthusiastic and proactive team player

. Your responsible will include:

• Drive pricing strategies across all portfolios, sectors and routes to market aligned closely with market trends and identify opportunities for margin improvement while improving customer value.

• Collaborate with sales, finance and delivery functions to identify new cross-portfolio opportunities, influence pricing strategy and execution.

• Track profitability of business and connect with business leaders for sharing timely insights and analysis

• Forecast revenue potential and market share based on market trends, costs, profit margins, and sales volumes.

• Maintain periodic communication of business analysis insights to executives, delivery teams, and sales staff and the progression of actions arising.

We are looking for an experienced Chartered Accountant Tax & Reporting to manage tax compliance, reporting, and audit support for operations across MENA and Asian countries. The role requires strong handson tax experience in multinational environments and excellent technical knowledge of direct and indirect taxes.

Key Responsibilities

• Handle monthly, quarterly, and annual tax reporting, including:

• Tax provisions

• Deferred tax

• Cash tax forecasts

• Foreign tax credits

• Prepare and review corporate income tax, VAT/GST, and withholding tax calculations and filings

• Ensure timely submission of tax returns and tax payments

• Prepare auditready tax disclosures, notes, and documentation

• Support statutory and tax audits

• Maintain accurate tax workpapers, reconciliations, and records

• Track tax law changes and assess business impact

• Support crossborder tax matters and treaty applications

• Review tax clauses in contracts and agreements

• Strengthen tax controls, documentation, and audit trails

• Manage einvoicing compliance requirements

• Identify opportunities for process improvement and automation

• Support adhoc tax and reporting assignments

Required Skills & Qualifications

• Qualified Chartered Accountant (CA)

• 3+ years of strong handson experience in taxation

• Experience with

• Corporate tax

• VAT/GST

• Withholding tax

• Multicountry tax compliance

• Working knowledge of GAAP / IFRS

• Strong proficiency in MS Excel

• Experience with ERP systems (SAP / Oracle preferred)

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills

• Ability to work in a fastpaced, multinational environment

Preferred

• Working knowledge of Arabic

Our Purpose

Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.

Title and Summary

Senior Accountant

Position: Accountant/ Senior Accountant, Net Revenue, GBSC
Job Description Summary
Overview:

• Are you motivated to work in a team that provides global services?
• Do you like to simplify, standardize, and transform existing processes?

This Position will provide excellent accounting services to Mastercard Worldwide as part of the Global Business Services Center (GBSC). The candidate will be responsible for delivering timely and accurate accounting services to our Mastercard Worldwide business unit(s) and will be responsible to support processes such as contract review to capture key financial elements, month-end close process, reconciliation & variance analysis for net revenue, rebate and incentive payment validation, processing, and approvals.

Role:

• Review executed contracts and create customers, deals and incentives in the Mastercard Contra Revenue System (CRS)
• Accomplish timely, accurate close of the CRS sub ledger and Oracle general ledger including creation and review of journal entries
• Identify and prepare manual journal entries through the analysis of close results, trends and actual to budget/forecast
• Prepare and review general ledger account reconciliations
• Perform detailed review of rebate and incentive payment requests including contract review and validation of driver data to various internal systems
• Provide overall support and customer service to business partners located throughout the Mastercard Worldwide organization
• Recommend, develop and implement process improvements to improve accounting operational efficiency, quality of output and optimize synergies
• Monitor performance indicators to track progress against goals
• Perform various ad-hoc reporting, analysis or projects, as needed
• Partner with financial systems regarding CRS requirements, data, reporting, and functionality
• Support SOX control compliance
• Other duties as required

All About You:

Education/Certification

• CPA/CA, preferred
• Inter CA, MBA Finance

Knowledge/Experience/Skills

• Knowledge of US GAAP and current accounting concepts
• Prior revenue, contra revenue, and/or contract management experience, preferred
• Strong verbal and written communication skills
• Strong customer service and business acumen
• Progressive accounting experience preferably in a large, global environment
• Ability to deliver accurate results in a fast-paced environment with attention to deadline constraints
• Robust understanding of financial/ERP systems, preferably direct experience with Oracle
• Prior experience in significant process improvements projects
• Organize and prioritize multiple activities among a team with a high sense of urgency
• Customer service oriented with the ability to communicate effectively and develop solid working relationships across multiple levels and organization boundaries
• Capable of working within a changing environment with excellent analytical, planning and organization skills

Corporate Security Responsibility

All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
• Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;

• Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;

• Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and

• Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

We are looking for a detail-oriented US Accountant with hands-on experience in US Accounting, US GAAP, NetSuite and QuickBooks Online (QBO). FP&A Vice President The Apex Group was established in Bermuda in 2003 and is now one of the world’s largest fund administration and middle office solutions providers. Our business is unique in its ability to reach globally, service locally and provide cross-jurisdictional services. With our clients at the heart of everything we do, our hard-working team has successfully delivered on an unprecedented growth and transformation journey, and we are now represented by over circa 13,000 employees across 112 offices worldwide.Your career with us should reflect your energy and passion.

That’s why, at Apex Group, we will do more than simply ‘empower’ you. We will work to supercharge your unique skills and experience. Take the lead and we’ll give you the support you need to be at the top of your game.

And we offer you the freedom to be a positive disrupter and turn big ideas into bold, industry-changing realities. For our business, for clients, and for you Apex Group Ltd., established in Bermuda in 2003, is one of the world’s largest financial service providers with 13,000 employees operating out of 100 offices in 50 countries. The Group has ~$.53 trillion assets under management and has delivered strong growth of >10% year on year for the last 3 years.

Apex Group offers a single source solution to customers for financial services as it has the broadest range of services amongst its competitors. These services include fund administration solutions, digital onboarding of bank accounts, depositary, custody and super ManCo services, corporate and family office services, business services including HR and payroll and pioneering ESG ratings and advisory service for private companies.

Global Capability

Centre FP&A Team India is growing as an Apex Group finance hub as it provides intelligent, enthusiastic, and energetic professionals to compliment a strong global finance team. This is a great opportunity to join the Global FP&A Team. The FP&A Team started with a 7-member team in 2021 in Phase 1.

Following early successes of the team and the need for increased reporting to stakeholders following a high number of recent business acquisitions, the team grew to ~30 members by 2026 in the subsequent hiring phases. We now have a team of technically strong and energetic employees and middle management professionals delivering an increasing number of data sets, standardized deliverables, and improved analytical reporting to assist the Global FP&A team in managing reporting for the entire portfolio of Group Companies. The FP&A organizational structure is relatively flat thereby increasing opportunities for everyone to grow and build a successful career.

We are looking to hire team members who will complement our world class high performing team. These roles are expected to drive data cleansing, standardized processing and be engaged with business, management, and finance teams across the globe.

The Role

This is an exciting opportunity for a Finance professional to join a high performing Global FP&A team operating in a fast growth Global Financial Services organization. We currently have an opening for a senior position - Vice President level. The Global FP&A team is functionally structured with Group Reporting (which includes synergy reporting as well), Revenue, People Cost and Other Expense Reporting and Partnering as the main pillars who also play a major role in stakeholder partnership and management.

The Entire

Team and each Pillar are led by extremely knowledgeable, experienced, dedicated, and professional leaders. Below are the key activities covered under the Vice President role: Close partnership with the FP&A Regional Finance, Business Leads and Cost Centre Owners Understand the main expense cost drivers while performing various activities under the different pillars (functions) of the Global FP&A Team to help perform better Perform and own day to day, monthly BAU activities and ad hoc requests Responsible for managing monthly financials for indirect cost Perform the Forecast and Planning activities Actual vs Plan Role Relocation / Target Operating Model Tracking Synergy Tracking Identify cost saves and risks for better cost control Do a Deep dive analysis of the P&L with detailed commentary on indirect cost for various Stakeholders The Leadership team (Global FP&A) Group Segment / Product Leads and Group Regional Heads Group CFO Group COO Assist the seniors in preparing various reports and dash boards (e.g.: Reports related to key cost drivers, top vendors driving cost, trend analytics including business insights etc.) Help in improvisation and enhancement of existing “Workday / Adaptive” system Lead and efficiently manage team to create a robust team culture with proper back up for processes, SOP & documentation Work towards automation (basis requirement), system transformation, innovation projects, enhancing processes for better control and analytics For Leadership roles, the leads will need to drive, own and work towards creating a robust structure functionally and administratively Skills Required: Minimum of 15+ years Financial Planning & Analysis experience with strong domain knowledge Qualified Chartered Accountant/CPA/CMA or MBA from top rated institute preferred Proficiency in Microsoft package (Word/Excel/Power Point). Power BI Knowledge is an added advantage Knowledge of Workday/Adaptive Planning (Group Management Reporting system) preferred Project Management Skills, Self-starter, Ability to multitask, good team player Take accountability and end-to-end ownership of the tasks managed Decision making capability and Attention to detail Customer Centricity (Stakeholder Centricity) Good Communication & Stakeholder Management skills Strong Time Management skills, ability to work under pressure Demonstrable use and management of large data sets Data analytics and visualization skills What will you get in return: A high level of visibility within a large organization which is on an upward trajectory Be part of a dynamic and fast-paced team that makes a visible contribution to Management decision making and deliver a tangible impact on the business.

Exposure to all aspects of the business, cross-jurisdiction and to working with a broad range of internal stakeholders. Opportunity to work with a diverse, agile and global finance and management teams.

Additional information: We are an equal opportunity employer and ensure that no applicant is subject to less favorable treatment on the grounds of gender, gender identity, marital status, race, color, nationality, ethnicity, age, sexual orientation, socio-economic, responsibilities for dependents, physical or mental disability. Any hiring decisions are made based on skills, qualifications and experience. We measure our success as a business, not only by delivering great products and services and continually increasing our assets under administration and market share, but also by how we positively impact people, society, and the planet.

Tasks

Objective:

To manage Monthly, half yearly and annual Closing of Books of accounts, Reporting as per Ind AS and IFRS, co-ordinate with Statutory, Regulators and Internal Audits, submission of various regulatory returns applicable, Monitoring Internal Control systems, ICOFR and Reconciliations.

A. Preparation of financial statements

1. To prepare & Review the Balance sheet, Profit & Loss statements, and schedules under IFRS for month end closure.

2. Review the inputs into the monthly reporting tool and ensure smooth closure of monthly reporting.

3. To prepare financial statements as per IND AS for regulatory reporting.

4. To maintain chart of accounts as per the headquarters guidelines

B. Regulatory Compliance:

1. To prepare various regulatory statutory returns on a weekly, monthly, quarterly, half yearly and on annual basis and submit the same with the regulator on a timely manner.

2. To ensure that the other regulatory certification and declaration such as FDI Certificate, Statutory Auditor’s Certificate are filed with the regulator’s on a timely basis.

3. To support in preparation of data for RBI related queries and Information sought from accounting.

4. To support the Regulator’s inspection from accounting and reporting standpoint.

5. Preparation of Liquidity Coverage Ratios & CRAR on monthly basis.

6. To prepare input for disclosures of various statutory financial and related information on the website of the Company on a timely manner.

7. To prepare and facilitate various regulatory reports for ALCO meetings.

8. To ensure all the relevant and applicable compliances are complied with and closed on a timely manner in the Compliance tool.

C. Audit:

1. To prepare the required balance sheet & P&L schedules as required during the Statutory audit.

2. To work closely with auditors and ensure that the financials contain all relevant disclosures applicable to the Company.

3. To review the audit observations and Management Letter and take it to the relevant team for response and closure.

4. To monitor and ensure the Internal Control Systems are in place as per the Mercedes- Benz Guidelines.

5. To ensure that the Internal Control on Financial Reporting are in place by demonstrating and documenting the controls in place.

6. To prepare presentations for various meetings related to audits like audit committee and board.

D. Accounting Reconciliations:

1. To review the statutory remittances carried out by Taxation and HR department and provide accounting clearance and facilitate nil / insignificant open items.
